about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a passionate software engineer with a focus on creating elegant solutions to complex problems. With experience across the full stack, I combine technical expertise with an eye for design and user experience.
about.p2: My journey into tech started with a curiosity about how things work. Today, I'm driven by the opportunity to build products that make a real impact on people's lives.
about.p3: When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open source, or sharing what I've learned with the community.
